steps.name: When I send a POST to "/auth/firebase/apply-action-code" with raw body "{invalid json"
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-18T07:05:50.365","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"The request body contains invalid JSON. Please check your syntax","path":"/api/auth/firebase/apply-action-code","requestId":"REQ-29dbe578"}
And the error message should contain "invalid JSON"
error body must carry the contract message
When I send a POST to "/auth/firebase/confirm-password-reset" with raw body "not json"
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-18T07:05:50.372","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"The request body contains invalid JSON. Please check your syntax","path":"/api/auth/firebase/confirm-password-reset","requestId":"REQ-8e0ec3ad"}
And the error message should contain "invalid JSON"
error body must carry the contract message
